# vcp_dns_domain (Resource)

Manages a DNS domain (zone). The zone is addressed by its name; there is no update operation, so changing `name` forces recreation. Names are canonicalized to a trailing-dot FQDN.

**Note:** creating a zone automatically provisions system NS records; those are not managed by Terraform and appear in the `vcp_dns_domain` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A DNS zone. The trailing dot is added automatically if omitted.
resource "vcp_dns_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.com."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Domain (zone) name, e.g. `example.com.`. Case and the trailing dot are not significant. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Domain identifier (equal to the canonical name).
- `is_delegated` (Boolean) Whether the zone is delegated to the provider's name servers.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# DNS domains can be imported by name.
terraform import vcp_dns_domain.example example.com
```
